snippet.title: Bardella and the Curse of Silence Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Bardella and the Curse of Silence is a 2D platformer/metroidvania with themes and mechanics based on music and sound. It follows the story of a bard named Bardella and her fight against the fight against the curse of silence that has beset her home!

Download the Demo, coming soon to Steam and Itch.io!
